author: toketrain
body:
Here we go! I had another go at making a DTM map! You spawn in a clock tower. There's iron in a pit right outside of spawn. There's a pond, some shipping crates and a crane, a swamp, a small ravine, a sewage level, a little volcano, hills, a little town, and more. The monuments are located on the crane, in the temple, and in the fire pit. (Just a side note: the fire pit monument looks very vulnerable at first, but it's surrounded by trees. It's also a good monument to tunnel to)

Mediafire Map Download (yml included, version 1.2)

Imgur Album

Pastebin yml

Feedback/suggestions would be appreciated!


Version 1.2:
Added more terrain
Added some boulders

New pics!
